title: FHGM draft transport overlay for FHGFF3 1.1 headers (proposal)
description: Transport-only overlay for native FHGM draft contract v0.1. It pins the released FHGFF3 1.1 file identity (docs/FORMAT.md R15 permits x- keys only from schemaVersion 1.1) and requires the repeatable x-fhgm-models record array. It intentionally does not describe record contents: each record validates against fhgm-model.schema.json in the separate model-level checker (validate_fhgm.py). The base FHGFF3 schema validates transport only; model-level meaning is never established by the base schema, and the file checksum covers every embedded record byte like any other header byte.
